ImageDescription.value: This is a photo I took of a waterfall from the main observatory of the Tapantí National Park in Costa Rica. This picture was taken on August 14, 2005. Tapantc National Park, sometimes called Orosí National Park, is a National Park in the Pacific La Amistad Conservation Area of Costa Rica located on the edge of the Talamanca Range, near Cartago. It protects forests to the north of Chirripó National Park, and also contains part of the Orosí River.
